meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 21 (DECISIONS 043, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new HP/HyperX models, 13 quotes, 1 identifier verified (HP 920), 4 stay pending (see catalog notes). HP official US store sweep 2026-11-06 (BUILD_LOG 059): hp.com/us-en product pages confirm model identity, MPNs and prices in page JSON-LD (all five InStock at the sweep prices); hyperx.com US store confirms the Alloy Rise 75 price and single variant. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{hp-omen-27s,hyperx-cloud-iii,hp-920-ergonomic-vertical-mouse,hp-omen-27q-g2,hyperx-alloy-rise-75}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~19:43-19:50 UTC (11:43-11:50 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. Black Friday sale prices (HP 920 $68.99 vs $114.99 list, OMEN 27q G2 $203.99 vs $339.99 list, Alloy Rise 75 $84.99 vs $169.99 list) should be re-checked after the event ends Nov 8. Correction vs sweep 059: the Cloud III Black-Red MPN is 727A9AA on the HP US product page, not 4P5M0AA (the sweep's bundle/upsell code); 4P5M0AA was not recorded. No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced identifiers (the Cloud III UPC 197029008237 is stated on Amazon listings only and was not recorded; the OMEN 27s UPC 197029615442 is also stated on Amazon but was not used as corroboration).
